propositions: Open or in-progress bugs with caused_by edges pointing to an epic or its descendants escape the direct-children close gate and must be deterministically blocked at epic-close verification.

A deterministic floor that enumerates open/in-progress bugs via their deps[] caused_by edges and blocks if any target resolves into the epic subtree prevents legitimate deliverable defects from closing without fix, re-parenting, or link dispute.

A candidate filter scoped to bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the subtree (any relation, both directions) and capped at 32 feeds a haiku relevance screen that classifies each as deliverable-defect (A), pre-existing/adjacent (B), or unrelated (C).

The verifier blocks only undispositioned A-verdicts (defects in deliverable) where disposition is proven via store-grounded signals: supersedes/duplicates links (either direction) or reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose; bare 'out of scope' does not qualify.

Screen verdicts ride a normalized schema with validator defaulting to C on malformation, and compact A-candidates (title+citation+id, max 8 rows+overflow count) are forwarded inside the fenced context for verifier adjudication on demand via show_ticket.

Screen tally including per-candidate verdicts and unevaluated-overflow count is recorded in the completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open with a logged reason and never blocks the close by itself.
